entries.english: Loaded on the van at …, waiting to leave
entries.note: The order is packed and loaded at WLKGO's warehouse in Hangzhou, the first row. The brackets name the warehouse.
The order leaves the warehouse for the delivery station the brackets name.
The delivery station received the order.
The courier takes the order out from the station. The carrier's text goes on to name the courier and a phone, which the adapter leaves out.

entries.english: Delivered, signed for by the customer
entries.note: The delivery is done and the customer signed.
